# TaskFlow Copilot Instructions

- This repository is a TaskFlow technical interview exercise. Read the applicable approved specifications in [`docs/`](../docs/requirements.md) before changing code.
- The specifications and decisions in `docs/` are approved and authoritative. Begin application work only when the owner assigns a development task.
- The approved API contract and business rules are authoritative. If code conflicts with them, report the conflict; do not silently change either side.
- Inspect existing files before editing. Keep changes in the assigned agent's ownership area and coordinate cross-area changes.
- Keep the implementation simple, test changes, and report modified files, decisions, and commands/results. Do not add out-of-scope features or commit secrets.
- See [`docs/agent-workflow.md`](../docs/agent-workflow.md) for role boundaries, handoffs, dependencies, and stages.
